paragraphs.text: Work-item workbench for the DSH right Sidebar: per-workspace todos with fuzzy search, inline editing
, and an idempotent write-back loop
# dsh-plugin-workbench

A work-item workbench in the DSH right Sidebar: every workspace keeps its own list of work
items, se

archable and editable in place, with a write-back loop that lets the model finish
them.
中文 README
## What it does

- **Per-workspace work items.** Items live in the workspace the conversation belongs to;
switching c

onversations switches the list. Nothing shows when a session is outside a
workspace.
- **Fuzzy searc

h.** One box searches title, description, and tag, scoring prefix > substring >
subsequence, then fa

lls back to recency.
- **Four filters with counts.** 全部 / 未完成 / 已完成 / 已归档 (`all / active / done /
ar

chived`), plus a filter-aware empty state.
- **In-place editing.** Create, rename, edit the descript

ion, set a tag, and archive an item
(reversible: the same button restores it). An item's status is w

ritten by the write-back
loop, not by hand.
- **Write-back.** Sending an item as 待办总结 (`write-back`)

posts it into the conversation;
the model's reply is written back onto the item, which completes it

self. The request is
idempotent, so a retry cannot duplicate a completion.
- **Small conveniences.**

Copy an item as Markdown, or fill its title into the composer.
- **Bilingual.** zh-CN and en-US UI
strings ship with the plugin.
## Requirements
| DSH | `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0` (declared as `engines.dsh`; the profile's compatibility check reads it

The DSH peer dependencies are pinned to exact `0.2.1-rc.2` versions on purpose: pnpm
resolves prerel
ease ranges unpredictably, so a range would install a mix of versions.
## Install
### From GitHub
[代码示例省略，未执行]

pnpm fetches the repository as a tarball. The built `packages/workbench/lib` is committed, so
the in

stall needs no build step — which also matters because pnpm blocks build scripts for
git-hosted pack
ages unless each exact tarball URL is allowlisted in the profile.
### From a local clone
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### Restart DSH

The Host half is loaded during boot, so a freshly installed plugin only appears after a
restart. Cli
ent-side edits alone need nothing more than a page refresh.
### Uninstall
[代码示例省略，未执行]

> **Before uninstalling a local-path install, back the clone up.** pnpm installs a directory
> as a

link (junction), and profile cleanup has been observed to follow such a link and delete
> files insi
de the linked directory. See `DESIGN.md` §0 for the incident.
## Usage

1. Open the right Sidebar and pick the 工作台 (`Workbench`) tab.
2. `+` creates an item in the current

workspace; the search box and the filter row sit above
the list.
3. Click a card's description to ed

it it inline: `Enter` commits, `Shift+Enter` adds a line,
`Esc` reverts.
4. `待办总结` sends the item in

to the conversation. When the model answers, the answer is
appended as the item's completion and the

. When the model answers, the answer is
appended as the item's completion and the item moves to 已完成.
## Storage

Items are stored through `@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-domain` in the workspace's own domain, so
they tr
avel with the workspace and never leak across workspaces.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`packages/workbench/lib` is committed because that is what an install consumes: rebuild it and
commi
t it together with any source change, or a fresh install keeps loading the old output.

- Host half: `packages/workbench/src/index.ts` → `lib/index.js`.
- Browser half: `packages/workbench

/src/client/**` → `lib/client.js`.
- The Typert manifests in `src/typert.host.ts` and `src/typert.re

mote-client.ts` are written by
hand because the upstream generator cannot analyze a plugin outside t

he DSH monorepo;
`tests/remote-contract.spec.ts` holds them to the shipped Remote contract, includin

g the
manifest shape the runtime loader requires.
- `prototype/` holds the static HTML prototypes th

e UI was designed against, and `repro/` a
mounting harness.
